name: Athrikus Narassin's Head
summary: This severed head is proof of the death of Athrikus Narassin, an ancient warlock who directed dark rituals in northern Darkshore. Taken from the heights of the ruined spire, it serves to confirm the disruption of demonic activity centered around the Tower of Althalaxx.

sections.title: Blight Upon Althalaxx
sections.body: Perched at the pinnacle of the Tower of Althalaxx, Athrikus Narassin commanded a coven of dark sorcerers practicing fel magic along the Darkshore coast. Ancient and entrenched, Narassin coordinated demonic summonings that threatened the surrounding wilderness. Claiming his head shatters the coven's leadership, driving back their immediate foothold in the region, even if the lingering corruption promises future vigilance will be needed.

faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin was an ancient and powerful warlock presiding over the cultists entrenched in the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. He directed the coven's demonic rituals from the very top of the spire.

Alliance scouts monitoring the Tower of Althalaxx require irrefutable proof that the master warlock has been slain. Presenting his severed head confirms his demise and marks the strike against the demonic forces as a success.
He resides at the very summit of the Tower of Althalaxx, situated in northern Darkshore, heavily guarded by his devoted cultists and summoned demons.

faq.q: Does killing him eliminate the demonic threat completely?
faq.answer: While Athrikus's death deals a severe blow to the dark ritualists and scatters their current operations, scouts believe the demonic forces will eventually regroup, requiring ongoing defense of Darkshore.

angles.text: Purging Athrikus Narassin removes a festering demonic blight from ancient Kaldorei ruins along the northern shores of Kalimdor.
Athrikus's mastery of fel powers made him a formidable practitioner, though his reckless visibility in Althalaxx proved his undoing.
